title: Organmancy
description: This mod adds many organ curious.
body:
This mod adds many organ curious.And made by Mcreator.It requires Biomancy2, Curios, and Pehkui as prerequisite mods.You can use the Bio-forge in Biomancy to make organs.The organs have different functions.
